ah.title: Achievement Helper
ah.hud.drag: Drag the outlined tracker to move it
ah.no_sync: Waiting for world data. Multiplayer servers must also install Achievement Helper to provide the full checklist.
ah.simultaneous_effects: Required at the same time (not cumulative):
ah.requirements_help: Every group is required. Inside an “any of” group, one option is enough. Percentages count completed groups.
ah.guide.fallback: Follow the in-game description above and complete the required groups below. Custom advancements may have additional rules defined by their mod or data pack.
criterion.achievement_helper.place_pale_: Activate a creaking heart by placing a pale oak log
criterion.achievement_helper.ocean_ruin_: Brush at a cold ocean ruin
Brush at a warm ocean ruin
criterion.achievement_helper.trail_ruins: Brush a common trail ruins block
Brush a rare trail ruins block
criterion.achievement_helper.distract_pi: Distract with a dropped gold item
Give gold directly to a piglin
criterion.achievement_helper.loot_bastio: Open a bastion hoglin stable chest
guide.achievement_helper.minecraft.story: Obtain a crafting table. Punch a tree, turn logs into planks, then use four planks in your inventory crafting grid.
Mine stone with a pickaxe and collect cobblestone, cobbled deepslate, or blackstone.
Craft and obtain a stone pickaxe using stone-tier material and sticks.
Smelt raw iron in a furnace or blast furnace, then collect an iron ingot.
Craft or find any iron armor piece and put it in your inventory.
Use an empty bucket on a lava source block. Flowing lava cannot be collected.
Craft or obtain an iron pickaxe. Three iron ingots and two sticks are enough.
Raise a shield before a skeleton's arrow hits you. Leave enough time for the shield to activate.
Pour water over a lava source, mine the resulting obsidian with a diamond or netherite pickaxe, and collect it.
Mine diamond ore with an iron pickaxe or better and collect a diamond. Looted diamonds also work.
Build a rectangular obsidian portal with an opening at least 2 by 3, light it, and step through.
Obtain any diamond armor piece; enchanting it is unnecessary.
Use an enchanting table to enchant an item. Bring lapis lazuli and experience levels.
Give a zombie villager Weakness, then use a regular golden apple on it. Keep it sheltered and wait for the cure.
Follow thrown eyes of ender, then enter the stronghold they lead to. Bring spare eyes because they can break.
Fill the stronghold portal's empty frames with eyes of ender and enter the activated portal.
guide.achievement_helper.minecraft.nethe: Travel into the Nether through a Nether portal.
Hit a ghast's fireball back at it and kill the ghast with the reflected fireball.
Enter a bastion remnant in the Nether. Gold armor does not make piglin brutes friendly.
Mine and collect ancient debris using a diamond or netherite pickaxe. Bring fire resistance for lava pockets.
Use the Nether to travel between Overworld portal positions at least 7,000 blocks apart horizontally. Nether travel scales 1:8.
Enter the bounding area of a Nether fortress. Search open lava oceans for its dark brick bridges.
Collect crying obsidian from a ruined portal, bastion loot, or piglin bartering.
Give a gold item to an adult piglin while it is attacking you. A gold ingot is a convenient choice.
Saddle a strider and ride it while holding a warped fungus on a stick.
Bring a ghast through a large Nether portal into the Overworld, then kill it there.
Open a loot chest in a bastion remnant. Prepare an escape route because nearby piglins become angry.
Obtain a full set of netherite armor. Upgrade each diamond armor piece at a smithing table with a netherite upgrade template and ingot.
Kill wither skeletons until one drops a skull, then collect it. Looting improves the drop chance.
Kill a blaze in a Nether fortress and collect a blaze rod.
Place a respawn anchor and charge it fully with four glowstone. Only use it to respawn in the Nether.
Bring a strider to the Overworld, then ride it on lava for at least 50 blocks from your starting position.
Enter every required Nether biome in the checklist. A portal or a safe tunnel network makes revisits easier.
Build a T of four soul sand or soul soil blocks, then place three wither skeleton skulls across the top. Place a skull last.
Use a brewing stand with blaze powder fuel and collect a brewed potion from a bottle slot.
Craft a beacon from a Nether star, glass, and obsidian. Place it on a valid mineral pyramid with an unobstructed beam.
Have every potion effect required by this version active at the same time. Prepare potions, a turtle master potion, and a safe setup before starting.
Activate a beacon on a complete four-layer mineral pyramid: 9×9, 7×7, 5×5, and 3×3 layers, totaling 164 blocks.

Apply every status effect required by this version simultaneously. Prepare potion effects plus environmental and mob effects in one location. Use the Wiki guide for a timed setup; this is one simultaneous condition, not a permanent collection checklist.
guide.achievement_helper.minecraft.end.r: Enter the End through a stronghold portal.
guide.achievement_helper.minecraft.end.k: Defeat the ender dragon. Destroy healing crystals first and bring a bow, blocks, and slow falling potions.
guide.achievement_helper.minecraft.end.d: Collect the dragon egg. Teleport it off the portal, then let it fall onto a torch or move it with a piston.
guide.achievement_helper.minecraft.end.e: Enter an End gateway to reach the outer islands. Throwing an ender pearl into its center is convenient.
guide.achievement_helper.minecraft.end.r: Place four end crystals, one at the center of each side of the exit portal, to start resummoning the dragon.
guide.achievement_helper.minecraft.end.d: Use an empty glass bottle on the purple dragon breath cloud to collect dragon's breath.
guide.achievement_helper.minecraft.end.f: Enter an End city on an outer island. Search large islands; some cities have an End ship.
guide.achievement_helper.minecraft.end.e: Collect elytra from the item frame in an End ship's treasure room.
guide.achievement_helper.minecraft.end.l: While affected by a shulker's Levitation, move at least 50 blocks vertically. Plan a safe landing or use an ender pearl to assist.
guide.achievement_helper.minecraft.adven: Kill a mob or be killed by one. Ordinary survival combat unlocks this tab.
Kill a raid captain outside a raid and collect the ominous bottle it drops.
Look directly at a parrot through a spyglass. Parrots spawn in jungles.
Kill any one of the eligible hostile mobs. This advancement has alternatives, so you do not need every listed mob.
Complete a trade with a villager or wandering trader and take the output item.
Fall alongside a honey block and slide down its side instead of landing on its top.
Fire a loaded crossbow. The projectile does not have to hit anything.
Let a lightning rod redirect lightning near a villager without setting the area on fire. Build the rod and villager shelter before a thunderstorm.
Sleep in a bed in the Overworld at night or during a thunderstorm.
Trigger a village raid using Raid Omen, then defeat the raid. Protect the villagers throughout the fight.
Look directly at a ghast through a spyglass while exploring the Nether.
Hit an entity with a thrown trident. Obtain a trident from a drowned that carries one.
Hit an entity with a projectile fired from a bow or crossbow.
Kill every required hostile mob at least once. Track this advancement and use the remaining checklist; mobs outside this version's requirements do not count.
Hold a totem of undying in either hand when you would otherwise die. Keep it equipped before taking the final damage.
Build an iron golem using four iron blocks in a T and a carved pumpkin or jack o'lantern on top, placed last.
Complete a villager trade at the world build limit. Transport the villager safely to the top before trading.
Use a Piercing crossbow to kill two phantoms with a single arrow. Weaken and align the phantoms first.
Kill a pillager using a crossbow.
Kill five different mob types with one crossbow shot. Use Piercing IV, line up weakened targets, and keep the projectile path clear.
Visit every required Overworld biome. Enter the biome itself; seeing it from a distance is insufficient. Use the checklist to plan missing destinations; only required biomes count.
Play a music disc in a jukebox located in a meadow biome.
Equip leather boots and walk on top of powder snow without sinking.
Look directly at the ender dragon through a spyglass.
Strike a villager with lightning. A Channeling trident during a thunderstorm is a controlled way to do this.
Kill a skeleton with a projectile from at least 50 blocks away horizontally. Mark a firing position and stop the skeleton from approaching.
Hit the exact center of a target block with a projectile from at least 30 blocks away. Practice the aim with a bow.
Fall from the Overworld build limit down to its bottom and survive. Prepare a clear shaft and a water landing before jumping.
Sneak near a sculk sensor or warden to avoid producing detectable movement vibrations.
Kill a mob that drops experience near a sculk catalyst so the catalyst blooms.
Place a comparator facing out of a chiseled bookshelf and interact with a book slot so the comparator reads it.
Use a smithing table to apply any armor trim template and a valid material to an armor piece.
Apply each required trim pattern at least once at a smithing table. The checklist shows the required templates; other patterns do not substitute.
Use a brush on suspicious sand or suspicious gravel and recover a pottery sherd.
Craft a decorated pot with four pottery sherds and no bricks. The sherd patterns may repeat.
Use a brush on an armadillo to obtain an armadillo scute.
Configure a crafter with the recipe for another crafter, then power it to perform the craft.
Enter a trial chamber underground. A trial explorer map from a cartographer can help locate one.
Scrape oxidation from a copper bulb with an axe to increase its brightness.
Use a trial key on a vault that you have not yet looted. Trial keys can be rewarded by trial spawners.
Use an ominous trial key on an ominous vault you have not yet looted. Obtain the key from ominous trials.
Kill a breeze with a wind charge you reflected back. Hit its incoming wind charge at the right moment.
Use a wind charge to launch yourself upward at least seven blocks. Aim beneath your feet and time your jump.
Deal at least 50 hearts of damage with one mace hit. Build enough fall height for a smash attack and choose a durable target.
Place a creaking heart between two pale oak logs with all three axes aligned, making the heart dormant or awake. It does not need to be night.
Hit at least five mobs during one spear charge attack. Gather targets in a line and keep the charge moving through them.
Use a compass on a lodestone to bind the compass to that block. The compass will point to it while you are in the same dimension.
guide.achievement_helper.minecraft.husba: Consume an edible item. Ordinary food such as bread is enough to start this tab.
Plant a valid crop, seed, or plant. A wheat seed on hydrated farmland is a simple option.
Feed two adult compatible animals their breeding food and wait for a baby to appear.
Tame an eligible animal. Wolves use bones, cats use raw fish, and horses require repeated riding.
Catch an item with a fishing rod and reel it in successfully.
Place a lit campfire below a bee nest or beehive, then use a glass bottle when its honey level is full. Keep the smoke path open.
Use a Silk Touch tool to collect a bee nest containing three bees. Wait until all three have entered before breaking it.
Eat every food required by the checklist at least once. Save rare foods and keep track of the remaining entries; drinks that are not required do not count.
Upgrade a diamond hoe with a netherite upgrade template and netherite ingot, then obtain the resulting netherite hoe.
Breed every required animal type. Some require special habitats or food; the remaining checklist uses the world's actual requirements.
Tame every required cat variant with raw cod or raw salmon. Search multiple villages; the black cat can also be found at swamp huts.
Use a water bucket on an eligible fish to collect it alive. Fish caught with a rod do not meet this requirement.
Use a water bucket on an axolotl. Look in the water of lush caves.
Help an axolotl kill its combat target and receive its regeneration effect. Bring an axolotl to an aquatic fight.
Use honeycomb on a waxable copper block to apply wax.
Use an axe on a waxed copper block to remove its wax.
Use a glow ink sac on a sign or hanging sign to make its text glow.
Get a goat into a boat, then ride in the same boat with it.
Give an allay an item, drop matching items nearby, and let it bring one back to you.
Give an allay a cake and activate a nearby note block. Drop another cake and let the allay deliver it to that note block.
Use a water bucket to collect a tadpole. Breed frogs with slimeballs to produce frogspawn first.
Attach leads to all three frog variants. Raise tadpoles in different temperature biomes to obtain the variants.
Obtain all three froglight colors. Different frog variants create different froglights when they eat small magma cubes; gather all three in your inventory.
Brush suspicious sand in a warm ocean ruin until you find a sniffer egg, then collect it.
Feed a baby sniffer torchflower seeds. Hatch a sniffer egg and keep seeds ready before it grows up.
Plant a torchflower seed or pitcher pod dug up by a sniffer.
Tame every required wolf variant with bones. Search different biomes for the variants shown in the checklist.
Use shears on your tamed wolf to remove its wolf armor.
Use armadillo scutes on your wolf while it wears damaged wolf armor to repair the armor.
Waterlog a dried ghast block by placing it in water or adding water to it. Leave it submerged if you want it to grow.
